name: settings
description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled after aligning their exterior and hub. Reviewed in Lab at source proportions, Regular 1.70, including rotation 30 degrees.
